text:
Alex P.: Heads-up — we need a small cross-team contract for the new per-1K-token cost dashboard. Telemetry wants runtime inputs (tokens emitted, cache hits, batching stats, GPU secs). Can runtime/infra teams agree on a minimal event schema?

Priya R.: we can emit RPC-level aggregates. propose: 
```
metric: redwood.inference.call
tags: model_variant, route, customer_tier, region, quantized
fields: tokens_generated, tokens_consumed, gpu_ms, batch_size, kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_lookups, queue_ms
```
We'll emit per-call and 1m rollups. note: high-cardinality tags = pain.

Linh T.: add model_shard/replica and kv_cache_bytes? for cache savings calc we need cache size + hit ratio. Also include warm_start bool (cache warm vs cold).

Riley (telemetry): this is great. a few constraints from telemetry side:
- prefer snake_case metric/field names for ingestion consistency
- avoid free-text customer ids; use hashed_customer_id tag for dashboards
- retention: raw per-call events TTL 7d, 1m rollups 90d, 1h rollups 2y
- cardinality: tags limited to ~200 distinct values per day in high-cardinality index

Proposal (short):
```
metric: redwood_inference_call_total
tags: model_variant, route, customer_tier, region, quantized, hashed_customer_id
fields: tokens_generated, gpu_ms, batch_size_avg, kv_cache_hit_count, kv_cache_lookup_count, warm_start
aggregations: sum(tokens_generated), sum(gpu_ms), avg(batch_size_avg), sum(kv_cache_hit_count), sum(kv_cache_lookup_count)
rollups: 1m, 1h, 1d
```
We can compute cost_per_1k = (gpu_cost + infra_share + mem_cost - cache_savings - batching_savings) / (tokens_generated/1000) in the analytics layer.

Daniel G.: For Console dashboards we'll need: per-route and per-model_variant breakdown, and a toggle to show either per-1k tokens or per-request. Also want an explicit "savings by feature" widget that attributes delta to KV-cache vs batching. How do we surface batching savings? need both baseline no-batching token/time and observed.

Priya R.: batching savings can be inferred if runtime emits batch_size distribution and a baseline single-request baseline_latency_ms/kernel_ms. We can estimate amortized GPU_ms per token. Suggest we emit `baseline_gpu_ms_per_token` as a config constant per model_variant (sent to telemetry as metadata) + runtime rollups with observed gpu_ms.

Marta S.: product asks for two slices: per-plan (free/pro/enterprise) and per-route (inference vs embeddings vs rerank). Are we able to guarantee route tag on runtime events? That's key for usage-based billing mapping.

Priya R.: yes route tag is available end-to-end in our router. will include `route` but keep cardinality limited (enum).

Riley (telemetry): items for infra to emit:
- node_gpu_seconds (per node) with tags: pool, accel_type, region
- instance_hours (for non-GPU infra)
- prefetch_cache_hits (edge-level)
We'll join node-level and request-level by minute and compute a per-minute unit cost.

Alex P.: ok to summarize into a lightweight contract we can check into infra repo? we want minimal fields to avoid explosion. Also need sampling guidance (sample 1% of calls for raw traces + full 1m rollups).

Priya R.: sampling: will emit full 1m rollups and sampled raw traces (1%). that should be fine.

Linh T.: small example event (raw) we'll emit from runtime for debugging: 
```
{
  "ts": 1779123456000,
  "route": "text_generation",
  "model_variant": "gptj-32b-q4",
  "tokens_generated": 812,
  "gpu_ms": 420,
  "batch_size": 3,
  "kv_cache_hit_count": 140,
  "kv_cache_lookup_count": 150,
  "warm_start": true,
  "hashed_customer_id": "h_7a2f..."
}
```
(We will not include raw prompt text in events)

Riley (telemetry): perfect. For dashboard metrics we'll create derived time series: 
- tokens_per_minute (sum tokens_generated)
- gpu_ms_per_minute (sum gpu_ms)
- kv_cache_hit_rate = sum(kv_cache_hit_count)/sum(kv_cache_lookup_count)
- batch_size_p50/p95
- estimated_cost_per_1k = (gpu_cost_per_ms * gpu_ms + infra_fixed_share - estimated_cache_savings - estimated_batching_savings) / (tokens_generated/1000)
We need a small config table: gpu_cost_per_ms by accel_type, infra_fixed_share per pool.

Daniel G.: UX ask: allow filtering by time-of-day and by rollout tag (canary vs stable). We also need ability to compare two time windows side-by-side (A/B).

Alex P.: rollout tag — runtime will pass `rollout: canary|stable|baseline` on events. keep as low-cardinality tag.

Marta S.: legal/privacy check — hashed_customer_id is fine as long as it's irreversible. ops sec signoff?

Priya R.: noted. PII never in telemetry.

schema-bot: schema registered: redwood_inference_call_total v1 (fields: tokens_generated, gpu_ms, batch_size, kv_cache_hit_count, kv_cache_lookup_count, warm_start)

deploy-bot: telemetry pipeline deploy queued — manifests changed in infra/telemetry/schemas/redwood_inference_call_total.yml

Riley (telemetry): Next steps:
- runtime (Priya/Linh) ship rollups + example events by EOD Fri
- infra (Daniel/Alex) provide dashboard wireframes + config table for cost constants by Mon
- telemetry (me) will add derived series and first-pass estimated_cost_per_1k formula, then share query + the calc in the infra analytics workspace.

Alex P.: thanks all. quick note: product wants this surfaced in Console -> Billing Insights (opt-in) and in a new "Cost per 1k tokens" widget. we'll iterate visuals after the first data pass.

Priya R.: ack. ping me if we need to trim tags or change sampling.

Linh T.: I'll put the example emitter in a PR (runtime/instrumentation) and link here.

Riley (telemetry): fyi — will use `redwood.inference` metric prefix in metrics backend for compatibility.

Marta S.: :thumbsup: good progress.
